name: Glimpse the Netherworld

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Trigger A living enemy you can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

---
As a creature slips into that final darkness, you tear through the fabric of reality to release the shadows of the Netherworld. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation from the triggering enemy takes 4d8 cold] damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, a creature also takes @item.level - 3d6 persistent,cold damage (double on a critical failure).

---
Heightened (+1) Increase the cold damage by 1d8 and the persistent cold damage by 1d6
